classification_definitions.projection_state: Replace repeated history folding with a restored, incrementally maintained projection or current-state field; preserve fork and resume semantics.
classification_definitions.bounded_historical_window: Replace the in-memory range lookup with an asynchronous bounded/paged reader carrying sequence, cancellation, and inherited-prefix semantics.
classification_definitions.complete_history_operation: Keep the operation until an explicit storage-backed complete/inherited-history reader proves equivalent ordering, errors, and fork/replay behavior.
classification_definitions.synchronous_invariant: The current caller validates an append/restore or identity invariant synchronously; replace it only with an equivalent pre-commit or owned validation seam.
classification_definitions.current_event: Use the delivered committed event or an owned projection instead of looking up an arbitrary historical position.
